name: Quicken
description:
Concentration, up to 1 minute.

Choose one:

  • Your speed doubles.

  • +1 half action on each of your turns.

  • +2 Defense

  • Your Dexterity rolls are favored.

At the beginning of each of your turns, you lose 1 Endurance for each effect you chose.

When you cast this spell, roll Lore to see if you trigger any additional effects.

Describe the spell's effects.
successes:
✨: Choose one additional effect.

🌞: Choose two additional effects.

💀: Your heart races wildly. Check two Conditions. You cannot uncheck those Conditions while this spell lasts.

improvements.name: Quicken
improvements.description: You may cast this spell on another creature within short range instead of on yourself.
